motive.canonical: The killer acted out of desperate greed and panic, believing that only by eliminating the victim immediately could they secure their financial future and prevent the revelation of past transgressions related to the inheritance.

method.canonical: Blunt force with the Brass till weight, in the storage room.

opportunity.canonical: Nadia Cole was at the cafe's rear door during the murder window and lied about being at the fountain.

explanation: The true motive wasn't the antique jewelry argument; it was the will itself. The victim had gathered all the evidence and was about to legally strip {KILLER_ID} of their rightful inheritance. Confronted with this imminent financial ruin, {KILLER_ID} panicked. They struck in a desperate attempt to secure their future, using the nearest object—the {WEAPON_NAME}—to silence the victim forever. The overly precise nature of their story and their practiced distress mask the cold calculation behind the fatal blow.
